description: This PHP class defines a component for delivery log processing in the Revive Adserver project, including methods for retrieving bucket and statistics table names, column definitions, and migration mappings.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_{GROUP}_{GROUP}Component
classes.description: A PHP class extending Plugins_DeliveryLog, responsible for managing delivery log buckets and statistics for a specific component.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of dependencies for this component.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for storing raw data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns an array defining the columns and their types in the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping configuration for migrating bucket data into statistics.
